title: tui: the issue page as panes
body: A pinned header card with the id in its border and the title inside; the posts in a pane of their own that scrolls; an about pane with filled badges, the dates and the ties as rows the cursor can move through: Tab moves onto them, Enter follows one, Esc comes back the way you came. Beside the posts from 90 columns, stacked under the header below that.
